items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-29
items.q: That's why I don't know why that tennis solo in there sounded like Hesham.

ctx.x: It sure gets a different sound from you. I don't want to put words in your mouth.

No, no, the sound is different. Like I told you, the comparison of people with different types of tonations in their horn. Now, that's Scott Bagby. That's why I don't know why that tennis solo in there sounded like Hesham.
That's why I don't know why that tennis solo in there.
